timing_semantics.clock_note: Initiator and responder use independent ESP32 clocks. Only durations measured within one board are directly timestamped; no absolute cross-board clock synchronization is assumed.
timing_semantics.handle_to_read_done_us: Responder-local time from handler entry through packet-length handling and RadioLib readData() completion.
timing_semantics.irq_to_handle_us: Responder-local time from SX1276 RX-done DIO0 callback timestamp to entry of handleReceivedPacket(). This includes firmware loop/scheduling latency.
timing_semantics.read_done_to_tx_start_us: Responder-local time from readData() completion through RSSI/SNR reads, H2 validation, PONG construction and getTimeOnAir(), up to the responder TX call.
timing_semantics.rtt_residual_us: Cross-node residual after subtracting measured local intervals. It is diagnostic only and must not be interpreted as propagation delay.
timing_semantics.tx_block_us: Responder-local blocking duration of transmitWithoutRxIsr(), including standby/driver work and the physical PONG transmission.
timing_semantics.wire_note: HW-002T does not change the H2 radio frame layout or HW2_VERSION=1. Timing data travels only over the responder USB serial log.
